tasks.name: Compile constructability input and lessons learned
tasks.description: Collects site, contractor and lessons-learned constructability requirements and issues them as design input for layout and engineering.

needs.info: site conditions: soil, climate, access routes, existing facility constraints, working-hour and labour restrictions
preliminary plot plan: unit boundaries, equipment locations, pipe rack runs, access ways
execution plan and contracting strategy: construction contract split, modular vs stick-built assumptions

tasks.name: Prepare site logistics, laydown and temporary facilities plan
tasks.description: Lays out laydown, fabrication yards, temporary buildings, haul roads and construction access around the plot.

needs.info: plot plan: plot limits, equipment coordinates, roads, maintenance access and drop zones
site grading and drainage plan, permanent roads, soil bearing at laydown areas
site access rules, existing underground services, available site area outside battery limits
facility siting results: exclusion zones for occupied temporary buildings (blast and fire contours)

tasks.name: Evaluate modularisation and prefabrication strategy
tasks.description: Compares stick-built, pre-assembled rack and skid/module options on cost, schedule, transport limits and site labour.

needs.info: plot plan and pipe rack layout: rack lengths, levels, areas that can be modularised
equipment list with weights, dimensions and package scope (skid vs field-erected)
schedule targets and estimate basis (labour rates, productivity, location factor)
transport route survey: maximum load dimensions and weights to site

tasks.name: Prepare heavy lift and crane study
tasks.description: Selects cranes, crane pads and lift sequences for heavy and critical lifts and states the space and lifting-lug requirements back to design.

needs.info: equipment erection weights, centre of gravity, dimensions, lifting and tailing lug locations (columns, reactors, exchangers)
certified GA drawings with shipping and lift weights and lift points
3D model: setting elevations, obstructions, crane access corridors (via Navisworks)
foundation locations, soil bearing for crane pads and underground services

tasks.name: Define path of construction
tasks.description: Sets the area-by-area construction sequence from underground through steel, equipment setting, piping, E&I and completions, driven by the commissioning sequence.

needs.info: preliminary system list and start-up sequence with required ready-for-commissioning dates by system
plot plan with areas, rack sections and equipment locations
project milestones: mechanical completion, start-up dates, contract interfaces
heavy lift plan: lift sequence and crane positions that constrain area sequence

tasks.name: Define construction work areas (CWAs)
tasks.description: Divides the plot into CWAs with boundaries and IDs aligned to the path of construction and plot plan areas.

needs.info: plot plan area / unit boundaries and grid coordinates
path of construction: area sequence

tasks.name: Define CWPs, boundaries and sequence
tasks.description: Breaks each CWA into discipline CWPs with scope boundaries, sequence and the dates by which engineering and materials are needed.

needs.info: CWA boundaries and path of construction sequence
WBS, deliverables register and level 2 schedule (engineering and procurement milestones)
line list and 3D model area breakdown to size piping CWPs (inch-dia, spools per area)
foundation and steel scope by area (quantities, structures list)
cable and raceway quantities by area
instrument index counts by area and type

tasks.name: Review 3D model for constructability (30/60/90 % reviews)
tasks.description: Reviews the federated model for erection access, rigging, scaffolding, weld access, spool breaks and construction sequence.

needs.info: S3D piping and equipment model at 30/60/90 % (via Navisworks into iConstruct)
Tekla structural model: steel, platforms, foundations (via Navisworks)
cable tray and major electrical equipment in the S3D model
instrument and junction box locations in the S3D model

tasks.name: Review IFR drawings for constructability
tasks.description: Comments on IFR drawings and specifications for field installability, tolerances, tie-in access and construction sequence.

needs.info: IFR GA drawings, tie-in list, sample isometrics, hydrotest philosophy
IFR foundation and steel drawings, anchor bolt plans
IFR cable routing and raceway layouts
IFR installation details and hook-ups

tasks.name: Prepare construction execution plan and estimate input
tasks.description: Writes the construction execution strategy and provides direct and indirect field hours, crew sizes and construction equipment for the estimate.

needs.info: estimate basis, WBS and location factors
piping MTO by size and class (inch-dia, weld counts)
civil and steel quantities (concrete m3, steel tonnes)
cable and raceway quantities
instrument counts and installation quantities
equipment list with weights and field-erected scope
modularisation decision and heavy lift plan

tasks.name: Develop construction schedule by CWP
tasks.description: Builds the level 3 construction schedule with resource-loaded CWP activities tied to EWP and material delivery dates.

needs.info: CWP breakdown, sequence and quantities
integrated level 2 schedule and engineering milestones
PO promised delivery dates and expediting forecasts by item
commissioning sequence and required subsystem turnover dates

tasks.name: Align EWPs and procurement packages to CWPs
tasks.description: Maps EWPs and purchase orders to CWPs and flags where engineering or material release dates miss the CWP need dates.

needs.info: deliverables register with EWP assignment and forecast IFC dates
requisition and PO list with ROS and forecast delivery dates (Purchasing DB extract)
CWP need dates for EWPs and materials

tasks.name: Build construction model and attach CWP/IWP attributes
tasks.description: Federates S3D and Tekla models in iConstruct, assigns objects to CWAs, CWPs and IWPs and links Jovix material status.

needs.info: S3D model export (piping, equipment) with line numbers, spool and iso numbers, via Navisworks
Tekla model export with assembly marks and foundation IDs, via Navisworks
S3D raceway and electrical equipment objects with tags
S3D instrument objects with tags
Jovix material status by item code, spool and PO line (received, in laydown, issued)

tasks.name: Develop installation work packages (IWPs)
tasks.description: Creates IWPs in iConstruct for one crew and one to two weeks of work, with scope, drawings, model views, materials and quantities.

needs.info: construction model with CWP assignment
IFC isometrics, spool drawings, support details and tie-in details
IFC foundation and steel erection drawings
IFC cable schedule, termination and raceway drawings
IFC hook-ups, installation details, loop and termination drawings
current IFC document revisions from Document Locator

tasks.name: Check IWP material availability against Jovix
tasks.description: Checks every IWP bill of materials against Jovix warehouse and laydown status and reports shortages before release.

needs.info: Jovix status: received, storage location, reserved and issued quantity by item code and spool
expediting forecasts for outstanding PO lines
IWP bill of materials

tasks.name: Manage IWP constraints and release IWPs
tasks.description: Logs and chases IWP constraints (engineering holds, RFIs, materials, scaffolding, permits) and releases constraint-free IWPs to the field backlog.

needs.info: IWP material shortage report and open RFIs by IWP
engineering hold list on isometrics and drawings
permit-to-work and isolation approvals for brownfield IWPs
subsystem priority and required turnover dates for IWP sequencing

tasks.name: Raise and manage RFIs
tasks.description: Raises requests for information against drawings and documents in Procore and tracks responses to closure.

needs.info: current IFC drawing and document revisions
RFI responses on piping (dimensions, supports, tie-ins)
RFI responses on foundations and steel
RFI responses on cable routing and terminations
RFI responses on installation and terminations

tasks.name: Raise field change requests
tasks.description: Proposes field changes where IFC design cannot be built or a better field solution exists, with cost and schedule impact.

needs.info: RFI responses that change design
change control procedure and approval thresholds
engineering disposition and revised drawings for field changes
owner approval of field changes affecting operability or scope

tasks.name: Survey, set out and verify foundations
tasks.description: Sets out grid and foundations, checks anchor bolt and embedded item positions and records as-built elevations before steel and equipment setting.

needs.info: IFC foundation drawings, anchor bolt plans and setting-out coordinates
certified equipment GA drawings: base plate and anchor bolt pattern
site survey control points and benchmarks

tasks.name: Request and receive materials from the warehouse
tasks.description: Raises material issue requests for released IWPs and reports shortages, damage and surplus found in the field.

needs.info: released IWP bill of materials
Jovix stock and storage location by item code and heat number

tasks.name: Track installed quantities and progress
tasks.description: Records installed quantities and IWP completion daily and rolls progress up to CWP and schedule.

needs.info: IWP scope and budget quantities
progress measurement rules of credit and WBS

tasks.name: Track welds and NDE
tasks.description: Maintains the weld log with welder IDs, NDE selection and results and repair rates by line and iso.

needs.info: IFC isometrics with weld numbers, line class, NDE percentage and PWHT requirements
material certificates and heat numbers for traceability

tasks.name: Prepare and execute pressure test packs
tasks.description: Assembles test packs (marked-up P&IDs and isos, test limits, blinds, test pressures) and runs and records hydro/pneumatic tests and reinstatement.

needs.info: test package limits, test medium and test pressure by line (hydrotest list)
IFC isometrics
IFC P&IDs for marking test boundaries
weld log complete and NDE accepted for lines in the pack
subsystem boundaries so test packs align with subsystems

tasks.name: Complete construction ITRs (A sheets)
tasks.description: Completes and signs construction check sheets by tag in Smart Completions as installation is inspected.

needs.info: ITR assignment by tag and subsystem in Smart Completions
installation specifications and hook-up details
cable schedule and termination details
equipment installation and alignment requirements; vendor installation manuals

tasks.name: Clear construction punch items
tasks.description: Works off punch items assigned to construction and records clearance in Smart Completions.

needs.info: punch list by subsystem with category and action-by

tasks.name: Prepare as-built redlines
tasks.description: Marks field deviations on IFC drawings (P&IDs, isometrics, cable routes, foundations) and transmits redlines for as-built drafting.

needs.info: IFC drawing set from Document Locator
approved field changes and RFI responses
foundation survey as-built data

tasks.name: Walk down and certify mechanical completion by subsystem
tasks.description: Walks down each subsystem with commissioning and owner, confirms A-ITRs complete and A punch cleared, and issues the MC certificate.

needs.info: subsystem boundaries and tag-to-subsystem register
punch list and ITR status by subsystem
pressure test and reinstatement records
owner walkdown participation and witness sign-off

tasks.name: Compile construction quality dossier
tasks.description: Collects weld, NDE, test, material traceability, calibration and inspection records per subsystem for the turnover package.

needs.info: weld log, NDE records, test pack records
material certificates and site receiving inspection reports
site installation and inspection records from vendor representatives

items.name: Constructability input register
items.content: Constructability requirements and lessons learned: access widths, crane corridors, preferred spool sizes, shop vs field work, sequence constraints, site labour limits.

items.name: Site logistics and laydown plan
items.content: Laydown and fabrication areas, temporary buildings, haul roads, construction gates, parking, temporary utility connection points.

items.name: Temporary facility and utility requirements
items.content: Temporary power demand, construction water, temporary building locations and loads, needed from civil, electrical and owner.

items.name: Modularisation and prefabrication decision
items.content: Selected module/skid/pre-assembled rack scope, module boundaries, maximum module dimensions and weights, shop vs field fabrication split.

items.name: Heavy lift and crane plan
items.content: Heavy lift list (item, weight, radius), crane selection, crane pad locations and loads, lift sequence and dates.

items.name: Lift and setting requirements to design
items.content: Requirements returned to design: lifting and tailing lug type and position, crane pad bearing, keep-clear zones, late-set equipment, leave-outs in steel and piping.

items.name: Path of construction
items.content: Area sequence and logic from underground to commissioning, with target dates by area and system, used to set engineering and procurement priorities.

items.name: CWA boundaries
items.content: CWA IDs, boundaries on the plot plan grid and area descriptions.

items.name: CWP breakdown and boundaries
items.content: CWP IDs, discipline, CWA, scope boundaries and budget quantities.

items.name: CWP sequence and EWP need dates
items.content: CWP start dates and the date each supporting EWP (IFC drawings and data) must be issued; sent to engineering and project controls.

items.name: CWP material required-on-site dates
items.content: Required-on-site (ROS) dates by CWP for equipment, bulks and fabricated spools and steel; sent to procurement.

items.name: Model review constructability comments
items.content: Model review comments by object and area: access, rigging, scaffolding, spool breaks, weld access, clashes with temporary works, with action-by discipline.

items.name: Drawing constructability comments
items.content: Comment sheets on IFR drawings and specifications: installability, tolerances, sequence, field welds, tie-in access.

items.name: Construction execution plan
items.content: Construction strategy, contracting split, organisation, work hours, temporary facilities, sequence and AWP approach.

items.name: Construction hours and indirects estimate input
items.content: Direct field hours by discipline and CWA, crew sizes, construction equipment, scaffolding and indirect costs for the estimate.

items.name: Construction schedule by CWP
items.content: Resource-loaded level 3 CWP and IWP activities with logic links to EWP, material and subsystem turnover dates.

items.name: EWP-CWP alignment and gap report
items.content: Mapping of EWPs and POs to CWPs with forecast vs need dates and gaps flagged for engineering and procurement.

items.name: Construction model with CWP/IWP attributes
items.content: Federated model with every object tagged with CWA, CWP, IWP and Jovix material status.

items.name: Installation work package (IWP)
items.content: IWP scope, model views, drawing list and revisions, bill of materials, quantities, hours, safety and quality requirements.

items.name: IWP material shortage report
items.content: IWP bill of materials vs Jovix availability: short items by item code, PO line and expected date.

items.name: IWP constraint log
items.content: Open constraints by IWP: engineering hold, RFI, material, scaffolding, permit, predecessor; with owner and need date.

items.name: Released IWP backlog
items.content: IWPs released to the field with planned start and crew, and backlog weeks by discipline.

items.name: Request for information (RFI)
items.content: Question against a drawing or document revision with location, marked-up extract, required response date and response.

items.name: Field change request
items.content: Proposed field change with reason, markups, affected drawings and tags, needing engineering disposition and owner approval.

items.name: Field change cost and schedule impact
items.content: Hours, material and schedule impact of each field change, for change control.

items.name: Foundation and setting-out survey record
items.content: As-built foundation elevations, anchor bolt positions and deviations against IFC, accepted or non-conforming.

items.name: Material issue request
items.content: Pick list by IWP: item code, quantity, heat number, required date.

items.name: Field shortage, overage and damage report
items.content: Shortages, damaged items and surplus found at the work face, by item code and PO line.

items.name: Installed quantities and progress
items.content: Installed quantities and percent complete by IWP, CWP and CWA, daily and weekly.

items.name: Weld log and NDE register
items.content: Weld numbers by iso, welder ID, NDE type and result, repairs and PWHT records.

items.name: Pressure test pack
items.content: Test limits on P&IDs and isos, line list, test pressure and medium, blinds and vents, punch before test.

items.name: Pressure test and reinstatement record
items.content: Signed test record, gauge calibration, reinstatement checklist and test pack status (tested, reinstated).

items.name: Completed construction ITRs (A sheets)
items.content: Signed A-ITR records by tag with status in Smart Completions.

items.name: Construction punch clearance status
items.content: Punch items cleared by construction with date and evidence.

items.name: As-built redline markups
items.content: Redlined P&IDs, isometrics, cable routes, foundation and layout drawings with field deviations, for as-built drafting by engineering.

items.name: Mechanical completion certificate
items.content: Subsystem MC certificate signed by construction, commissioning and owner, with outstanding B punch attached.

items.name: Construction quality dossier
items.content: Per subsystem: weld and NDE records, test records, material traceability, calibration and inspection reports.
